text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Surely, this must be a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To think that I'm allowed to exist in the 
racing world. To think that I can run with 
all my might! It feels unrealistically 
joyful, beautiful as a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Let's enjoy this to the fullest. Let's 
dream a wonderful dream. And let's bring 
back—more memories than we can carry."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Serious training with Fine Motion begins 
as we prepare for her debut in the Twinkle 
Series. And there—
choice_data_list:
First, I want to check your current 
abilities.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Well then, off for my run!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...âª One more! Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she was simply born different. Her 
balanced muscularity and powerful stride 
captivate all who watch. Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Phew~...♪ That was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her greatest charm is her pure, 
unadulterated joy in running. That 
attitude will surely be a weapon moving 
forward. However—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mind if I run one more lap? I'm just 
itching to go!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, why? I can still run, you know?
choice_data_list: Overdoing it is a no-go, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to certain "special" circumstances, 
she has never trained up until now. 
Putting a sudden heavy load on her could 
lead to injury.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But you know, my legs are screaming, "I 
wanna run~!" ...So please—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion stumbles slightly. Just as she 
wavers—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: —Your Highness!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, Captain...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who came rushing over in a hurry 
was an Umamusume in a suit. She is—Fine 
Motion's bodyguard.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps your health has taken a turn for 
the worse. Let us arrange for a 
comprehensive examination. I shall make 
the arrangements at once.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I merely stumbled a little. There is no 
problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
No, it would be a disaster if anything 
happened to Your Highness. You are, after 
all, the descendant of a royal family... 
Your father strictly commanded me to 
protect you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume of highborn lineage. 
Currently residing in Ireland, her father 
is a high-ranking government official. She 
came to study abroad under the condition 
of "absolute safety."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So you were worried about my position too, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: It's not about status—it's for the race.
It's not about status—it's for the race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list:
If you overdo it, you won't be able to 
race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Yeah... that's it. After 
all, I'm the one running the race!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I won't push myself too hard 
anymore! I'll listen properly to what you 
say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Which is why... Captain. Would you please 
believe in and watch over me and my 
Trainer? I promise I will properly uphold 
our "standing" as well.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
...I am well aware of Your Highness's 
wisdom. Please take utmost care of 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"One last thing. May I have a moment of 
your time after training? A certain 
someone has reached out with a message—"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"—Fine. It looks like you are working 
hard."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Father!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Displayed on the PC screen was a dignified 
man— Fine Motion's father.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Due to official duties, contacting you 
like this will become rare. Therefore, 
once more, I wished to speak with you... 
and your Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"As thou art already aware, Fine's 
circumstances are not governed solely by 
her own will."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"However, Fine proved her potential to 
this father, and was granted three years 
of freedom."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"A new 'homeland' that warmly welcomed my 
family when we drifted ashore from distant 
lands— Ireland."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"We exist now for the sake of Ireland. As 
our mission is to work for them, returning 
home means no more racing. All of this is 
only for these three years."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I ask you once more. Are you truly 
prepared to be entrusted with my 
daughter?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fine Motion, and her father... Stared 
down by eyes so alike. But even without 
being asked again, my mind was already 
made up."
choice_data_list:
I'll support her dream with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Never, ever forget those words. Fine, 
run to your heart's content under this 
person's care."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text: "Watching over you, from the 'homeland'—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, and... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Come have ramen with me! I ran so much 
during today's training that I'm super 
hungry.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, I almost forgot! I need to 
introduce myself properly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For the next three years, I expect great 
work from you as my trainer. I look 
forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know a great place just up ahead! It's a 
dried-sardine broth ramen shop, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike ordinary Umamusume, she has an 
inevitable deadline from the very start. 
What I can do for her is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hurry, hurry♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She smiles so happily just going to get 
ramen... I will support her, so every 
single moment shines its brightest.
